exact: circulatory renin-angiotensin regulation of blood pressure
related: circulatory renin-angiotensin control of blood pressure
control of blood pressure by circulatory renin-angiotensin

definition: The process in which angiotensinogen metabolites in the bloodstream modulate the force with which blood passes through the circulatory system. The process begins when renin is released and cleaves angiotensinogen.
label: regulation of systemic arterial blood pressure by circulatory renin-angiotensin
